originalText: With one attack, the Gölge can finish Hi, Hono, Kagari, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Straumr, Göl, Gölge and Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.
speechText: With one attack, the GURL-geh can finish Hee, HOH-noh, kah-GAH-ree, RAH-dee, oo-MEH-meh, kee-moo-BOON-gah, Shore, STROWM-ur, Gurl, GURL-geh and kah-rahn-luk. Every unlit card survives that single hit.
